from fractions import Fraction as F
from pathlib import Path
import json
dot=lambda u,v:sum((x*y for x,y in zip(u,v)),F(0))
projection_pairings=0
for n in range(2,17):
 w=[F(i+1) for i in range(n)]
 for seed in range(-5,6):
  a=[F((i+seed)%7-3,3) for i in range(n)]
  b=[F((2*i-seed)%9-4,4) for i in range(n)]
  da=[F(i+1)*x for i,x in enumerate(a)]
  db=[F(2*i-1)*x for i,x in enumerate(b)]
  value=[x+y for x,y in zip(da,db)]
  projected=[dot(value,w)/dot(w,w)*x for x in w]
  for c in [F(-2),F(0),F(3,2)]:
   f=[c*x for x in w]
   df1=[F(i+1)*x for i,x in enumerate(f)]
   df2=[F(2*i-1)*x for i,x in enumerate(f)]
   assert dot(projected,f)==dot(a,df1)+dot(b,df2)
   projection_pairings+=1
tail_checks=cancellations=0
for n in [1,2,4,8,16,32,64]:
 a=[F(1,j) for j in range(1,n+1)]
 d=[F(j)*x for j,x in enumerate(a,1)]
 assert dot(a,a)<=2 and dot(d,d)==n and d[0]==1
 assert [x-y for x,y in zip(d,d)]==[F(0)]*n
 cancellations+=1
 for m in [n+1,2*n,4*n]:
  tail=sum((F(1,j*j) for j in range(n+1,m+1)),F(0))
  assert tail<=F(1,n)-F(1,m)
  tail_checks+=1
v=dict(passed=True,projected_pairing_cases=projection_pairings,unprojected_divergence_growth_and_cancellation_cases=cancellations,exact_tail_checks=tail_checks,arithmetic='fractions.Fraction exact; finite truncation checks, not an independent proof of IBM graph density')
Path('.lake/stardust-1299-exact-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
print(v)
